notes: «قال سألت لاحقا» (Imran asked Lahiq): Lahiq is the one asked and answers, so he is a link (rule 5).
«أبي» (Ubayd Allah's father, unnamed) is a relation link.
«فاضطر الحديث إلى أم سلمة فقالت أم سلمة»: the same woman written twice in succession is one link (rule 7); the saying is her account of the Prophet's practice.
Muawiya's question and Ibn al-Zubayr are in Lahiq's answer as scene, not links.
